strings.zh: 我不是真的火箭队员,{NEWLINE}我只是觉得火箭队那种{CLEAR}人见人怕的气势真的很帅。{CLEAR}所以就买了一身假制服模仿他们,{CLEAR}仅此而已！

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『我凭什么相信你说的话。

strings.zh: 哎呀,我现在就把制服脱了就是。
strings.en: Ugh, fine, I’ll take off{NEWLINE}the uniform right now.

strings.zh: 你看,火箭队员没有在制服里面{NEWLINE}穿成这样的吧。{CLEAR}我就只是在这一带玩而已,{CLEAR}拜托你不要抓我。
strings.en: See? No Team Rocket grunt wears{NEWLINE}something like this under the uniform.{SCROLL}I was just messing around{NEWLINE}here. Please don’t arrest me.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『好吧,看你的年龄、气质、打扮{NEWLINE}也确实不像火箭队。{CLEAR}我这次就放过你。{CLEAR}但是你要明白,{CLEAR}火箭队给这里的人们{CLEAR}带来过很深的伤痛。{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}『你穿个假制服{NEWLINE}自娱自乐拍张照片也就算了,{CLEAR}居然还要穿出来吓唬别人,{CLEAR}遇到吓不住的就使用暴力,{CLEAR}你这就是在污辱自己的人格、{CLEAR}惊吓路过的行人、{CLEAR}刺激那些被伤害过的人！
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: All right. Judging by{NEWLINE}your age, manner and clothes,{CLEAR}you really don’t seem like Team{CLEAR}Rocket. I’ll let you go this time.{SCROLL}But understand this: Team Rocket has{NEWLINE}caused the people here deep pain.{SCROLL}{VAR:0103:0}: Wearing a fake uniform for{NEWLINE}fun and taking photos is one thing.{SCROLL}But you wore it out to scare{NEWLINE}people, and used violence on{CLEAR}anyone who wasn’t scared.{SCROLL}You’re degrading yourself,{NEWLINE}frightening passersby, and reopening{CLEAR}the wounds of people who were hurt!

strings.zh: 呜呜呜……对不起,{NEWLINE}我也没意识到会有这么坏的影响。{CLEAR}我以后再也不敢了。
strings.en: Waaah... I’m sorry. I didn’t{NEWLINE}realize it would have such a bad{CLEAR}effect. I’ll never do it again.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『你知道就好。{NEWLINE}希望你以后能明辨是非,{CLEAR}去向好的榜样学习。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: As long as you understand. I{NEWLINE}hope from now on you can tell right from{CLEAR}wrong, and learn from good role models.

strings.zh: 请你放心,我以后一定做一个好人！
strings.en: Don’t worry, from now on I’ll{NEWLINE}definitely be a good person!

strings.en: From now on I’ll help others as much{NEWLINE}as I can, to make up for what I did.

strings.zh: 我的顿甲非常亲人,{NEWLINE}它还是小小象的时候,{CLEAR}经常一个飞跃冲进我的怀里。{CLEAR}可是现在它已经进化成顿甲了,{CLEAR}再像以前那样飞冲我,我可受不了。{CLEAR}但我每次制止它冲向我的时候,{CLEAR}它就会变得很不开心。{SCROLL}我听说有种特别厚实的道具{NEWLINE}叫作护身防具,{CLEAR}如果有那个的话,{CLEAR}应该就不用怕顿甲冲撞我了。
strings.en: My Donphan is super affectionate.{NEWLINE}Back when it was a little Phanpy,{CLEAR}it’d often leap right into my arms.{SCROLL}But now that it’s evolved{NEWLINE}into Donphan, I can’t take it{CLEAR}charging at me like it used to.{SCROLL}And every time I stop it from{NEWLINE}charging at me, it gets really upset.{SCROLL}I heard there’s a really thick{NEWLINE}item called a Protector. If I had{CLEAR}one of those, I wouldn’t have to{CLEAR}worry about Donphan ramming me.

strings.zh: 多谢你给的护身防具,{NEWLINE}现在顿甲可以放心地冲进我怀里了。
strings.en: Thanks for the Protector. Now Donphan{NEWLINE}can charge into my arms all it wants.

strings.zh: 年轻人,你也看到我这里{NEWLINE}养了不少向日花怪吧。{CLEAR}其实关于这些向日花怪有一段故事哦。{CLEAR}你想听听吗？
strings.en: Young one, you can see I raise{NEWLINE}quite a few Sunflora here.{SCROLL}There’s actually a story behind these{NEWLINE}Sunflora. Would you like to hear it?

strings.zh: 哎呀,不想听吗……
strings.en: Oh my, you don’t want to hear it...

strings.zh: 这大概是五十年多前的事了。{NEWLINE}当时精灵联盟都还没成立呢,{CLEAR}我的爱人玛露雀儿{CLEAR}为了磨炼自己的训练家技艺,{CLEAR}独自一人踏上了口袋妖怪之旅。{CLEAR}可是到了约定回来的时间,{CLEAR}我所爱的玛露雀儿却没有出现。{CLEAR}原来是玛露雀儿在旅行中发生了意外,{CLEAR}有一段时间失去了记忆。{CLEAR}但我不知道他发生了意外,{CLEAR}就在我几乎要放弃等他的时候,{CLEAR}我收到了他的来信,{CLEAR}信上是这么写着的：{CLEAR}没能如约回去陪伴你,{CLEAR}真的非常对其不起,{CLEAR}如果你已经结婚过上了幸福的生活,{CLEAR}我就不回去了。{CLEAR}可是如果你还在等我的话,{CLEAR}就请在农场摆上黄色的向日花怪吧。{SCROLL}于是我开始学着如何收服精灵,{NEWLINE}如何训练精灵,{CLEAR}终于在不知道走了多少路、{CLEAR}受了多少伤之后{CLEAR}收服了这四只向日花怪。{CLEAR}玛露雀儿回到这里时,{CLEAR}看到了我放在外面的向日花怪,{CLEAR}所以才能骨起勇气来与我相见,{CLEAR}最终我们在一起过上了幸福的生活。{SCROLL}但是好景不长,{NEWLINE}玛露雀儿因为伤势复发,{CLEAR}没多久他就过世了……
strings.en: This was over fifty years ago, before{NEWLINE}the Pokémon League was even founded.{SCROLL}My beloved Marcel set out alone on a{NEWLINE}Pokémon journey to hone his{CLEAR}skills as a Trainer.{SCROLL}But on the day he’d promised to return,{NEWLINE}my dear Marcel didn’t appear.{SCROLL}It turned out Marcel had an accident{NEWLINE}on his travels and lost his memory{CLEAR}for a while.{SCROLL}But I didn’t know he’d had an accident.{NEWLINE}Just as I was about to give up waiting,{CLEAR}I got a letter from him.{SCROLL}It said: ‘I’m truly sorry I couldn’t{NEWLINE}come back to you as I promised.{SCROLL}If you’re already married and living a{NEWLINE}happy life, I won’t come back.{SCROLL}But if you’re still waiting for me, please{NEWLINE}put yellow Sunflora out on the farm.’{SCROLL}So I started learning how to catch and{NEWLINE}train Pokémon.{SCROLL}And after who knows how many miles{NEWLINE}and injuries, I finally caught{CLEAR}these four Sunflora.{SCROLL}When Marcel came back here, he saw the{NEWLINE}Sunflora I’d put outside and found the{CLEAR}courage to come and see me.{SCROLL}In the end, we lived happily together.{SCROLL}But happiness didn’t last. Marcel’s old{NEWLINE}injuries came back, and before long he{CLEAR}passed away...
strings.notes: 玛露雀儿 (the Sunflora lady's husband) → Marcel (invented, low confidence). D-1480: shortened to fit the 1,024-unit field message buffer (minimal edits, rechecked against zh).

strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: Granny...

strings.zh: 今天是我们结婚五十周年纪念日,{NEWLINE}不知道这些向日花怪还能不能{CLEAR}再一次把玛露雀儿带回我的身边。{SCROLL}可能的话,真想跟他一起{NEWLINE}庆祝这个纪念日啊。
strings.en: Today is our fiftieth wedding{NEWLINE}anniversary. I wonder if these{CLEAR}Sunflora can bring Marcel{CLEAR}back to my side one more time.{SCROLL}If only I could, I’d love to{NEWLINE}celebrate this anniversary with him.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『原来这些向日花怪{NEWLINE}竟饱含着您那么多的回忆。
strings.en: {VAR:0103:0}: So these Sunflora{NEWLINE}hold so many of your memories.

strings.zh: {VAR:0103:0}『呜呜呜……老奶奶,{NEWLINE}您的故事好感人啊！

strings.zh: 不好意思,破坏你们的气氛了。

strings.zh: 刚才老太婆给你讲的故事全是假的。

strings.zh: 我就是刚才她故事里的玛露雀儿,{NEWLINE}如你所见身体健康着呢。{CLEAR}我老婆这个人喜欢看电影,{CLEAR}所以总爱讲一些虚构的故事。{CLEAR}你听听就好,不要太当真。
strings.en: I’m Marcel, the one from her story.{NEWLINE}As you can see, I’m alive and well.{SCROLL}My wife loves watching movies,{NEWLINE}so she’s always telling made-up{CLEAR}stories. Just enjoy them, and{CLEAR}don’t take them too seriously.

strings.en: Would you like to buy some more?{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 我们家大奶罐生病了,{NEWLINE}最近都产不出牛奶来了。{CLEAR}爸妈他们都快急死了,{CLEAR}唉,可怎么办啊。
strings.en: Our Miltank are sick, so they{NEWLINE}haven’t given any milk lately.{SCROLL}Mom and Dad are worried sick.{NEWLINE}Sigh... What are we going to do?

strings.zh: 听说大奶罐最近身体不好,不要紧吧……
strings.en: I heard the Miltank haven’t been{NEWLINE}well lately. I hope they’re OK...

strings.zh: 我在农场干了一辈子了,{NEWLINE}还从来没见过大奶罐出现这样的病症。
strings.en: I’ve worked on this farm{NEWLINE}my whole life, and I’ve never{CLEAR}seen Miltank get sick like this.
{VAR:FF01:200}Gold: Idol!!!{VAR:FF01:100}

strings.zh: 阿金『我已经获得魅影徽章{NEWLINE}正式成为中级训练家了。{CLEAR}跟从若叶镇出发的时候相比,{CLEAR}我和伙伴们都成长了好多。{SCROLL}阿金『我想现在跟偶像来一场对战,{NEWLINE}确认一下自己目前的水平。{CLEAR}偶像你可不要推辞哦！
strings.en: Gold: I’ve got the Fog Badge and I’m{NEWLINE}officially an Intermediate Trainer now!{SCROLL}My partners and I have grown so{NEWLINE}much since we left New Bark Town.{SCROLL}Gold: I want to battle you right{NEWLINE}now, Idol, and see where I stand.{SCROLL}Don’t you dare say no, Idol!

strings.zh: 阿金『真不愧是偶像！{NEWLINE}我还以为在训练家这条路上{CLEAR}已经能够看到偶像的尾灯了,{CLEAR}没想到差距居然还是这么大。{SCROLL}阿金『不过收集城都地区徽章的比赛{NEWLINE}我现在可没有落后。{CLEAR}等咱们都集齐了城都地区的8枚徽章,{CLEAR}我再跟偶像比试一次！
strings.en: Gold: That’s my idol! I thought{NEWLINE}I could finally see your{CLEAR}taillights on the Trainer road,{CLEAR}but the gap is still this huge.{SCROLL}Gold: But I’m not falling behind in{NEWLINE}the race for the Johto Badges!{SCROLL}Once we’ve both got all eight Johto{NEWLINE}Badges, I’ll challenge you again, Idol!

strings.zh: 水晶『前辈,你和阿金走得好快啊。{NEWLINE}要追上你们可真不容易。{CLEAR}我听说浅葱市的港口开放了,{CLEAR}水都群岛的涨潮季也已经结束,{CLEAR}如果现在坐船去水都群岛,{CLEAR}应该能抓到不少稀有精灵。
strings.en: Crystal: You and Gold move so fast.{NEWLINE}It’s really hard to keep up with you.{SCROLL}I heard Olivine City’s harbor is{NEWLINE}open, and high-tide season in{CLEAR}the Alto Mare Islands is over.{SCROLL}If we took a ship to the Alto Mare{NEWLINE}Islands now, we could probably{CLEAR}catch lots of rare Pokémon.

strings.zh: 水晶『不过我现在还是要{NEWLINE}优先收集城都地区的精灵。{CLEAR}像浅葱市周围的水域{CLEAR}应该就很有探索的价值,{CLEAR}我先去那边看看咯。
strings.en: Crystal: But for now, I want to focus{NEWLINE}on catching Johto Pokémon first.{SCROLL}The waters around Olivine City{NEWLINE}should be well worth exploring,{CLEAR}so I’ll go take a look there.
